```{ojs}
API_BASE = window.SEQUOIA_API_BASE || ""

apiJson = async path => {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}${path}`)

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `API indisponible (${path}) : HTTP ${response.status}`
    )
  }

  return await response.json()
}

dashboardPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/publications")
labsPayload = await apiJson("/api/dashboard/labs")

publications = dashboardPayload.items ?? []
publicationLabsCluster = labsPayload.items ?? []
```

```{ojs}
yearOptions = [
  "Toutes",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.year)
        .filter(d => d != null)
        .map(d => String(d))
    )
  ).sort()
]

pillarOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.pillar)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "")
    )
  ).sort()
]

axisOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publications
        .map(d => d.axis)
        .filter(
          d =>
            d &&
            d.trim() !== "" &&
            d !== "No class"
        )
    )
  ).sort()
]

labOptions = [
  "Tous",
  ...Array.from(
    new Set(
      publicationLabsCluster
        .map(d => d.lab)
        .filter(d => d && d.trim() !== "")
    )
  ).sort()
]
```

```{ojs}
html`

</section>
`
```

```{ojs}
publicationKey = d => d.publication_id ?? d.halId_s

selectedLabPublicationIds = new Set(
  selectedLab === "Tous"
    ? publications.map(publicationKey)
    : publicationLabsCluster
        .filter(d => d.lab === selectedLab)
        .map(d => d.publication_id ?? d.halId_s)
)

filteredPublications = publications.filter(d =>
  (selectedYear === "Toutes" || String(d.year) === selectedYear) &&
  (selectedPillar === "Tous" || d.pillar === selectedPillar) &&
  (selectedAxis === "Tous" || d.axis === selectedAxis) &&
  (selectedLab === "Tous" || selectedLabPublicationIds.has(publicationKey(d)))
)
```

```{ojs}
totalPublications = filteredPublications.length

withAxisPublications =
  filteredPublications.filter(
    d =>
      d.axis &&
      d.axis.trim() !== "" &&
      d.pillar !== "No class"
  ).length

noClassPublications =
  filteredPublications.filter(
    d => d.pillar === "No class"
  ).length
```

```{ojs}
publicationsByYear = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(
    filteredPublications,
    v => v.length,
    d => String(d.year)
  ),
  ([year, count]) => ({year, count})
)
.filter(d => d.year !== "null")
.sort((a, b) => Number(a.year) - Number(b.year))

publicationsByPillar = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(
    filteredPublications,
    v => v.length,
    d => d.pillar || "Non renseigné"
  ),
  ([pillar, count]) => ({pillar, count})
)
.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)

publicationsByAxis = Array.from(
  d3.rollup(
    filteredPublications.filter(
      d =>
        d.axis &&
        d.axis !== "Non classifié"
    ),
    v => v.length,
    d => d.axis
  ),
  ([axis, count]) => ({axis, count})
)
.sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)
.slice(0, 10)

topCitedPublications = filteredPublications
  .filter(
    d =>
      d.citations != null &&
      d.citations !== "" &&
      !Number.isNaN(Number(d.citations))
  )
  .slice()
  .sort((a, b) => Number(b.citations) - Number(a.citations))
  .slice(0, 10)

shortAuthors = value => {
  const authors = String(value || "")
    .split(/\s*\|\s*|,\s*/)
    .filter(Boolean)

  if (authors.length <= 2) return authors.join(", ")

  return `${authors.slice(0, 2).join(", ")} +${authors.length - 2}`
}
```

::: {.ranking-card}

```{=html}
<div class="ranking-heading citations-heading">
  <div class="citations-heading-row">
    <div>
      <h3>Publications les plus citées</h3>
      <p class="citations-subtitle">Top 10 selon OpenAlex.</p>
    </div>
    <button id="refresh-citations" class="citations-refresh-button" disabled title="Actualiser les citations de toutes les publications validées"><span aria-hidden="true">↻</span> Actualiser</button>
  </div>
  <p id="citations-date" role="status">Chargement des dates…</p>
  <p id="citations-progress" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
</div>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const base = window.SEQUOIA_API_BASE || "";
  const button = document.getElementById("refresh-citations");
  const message = document.getElementById("citations-progress");
  const date = document.getElementById("citations-date");
  let enabled = false;
  async function api(path, options = {}) {
    const response = await fetch(base + path, options);
    const data = await response.json();
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || `HTTP ${response.status}`);
    return data;
  }
  async function dates() {
    const data = await api("/api/dashboard/citations-status");
    date.textContent = data.last_updated_at
      ? `Dernière actualisation : ${new Date(data.last_updated_at).toLocaleString("fr-FR")}`
      : "Aucune mise à jour des citations enregistrée.";
  }
  async function poll(id) {
    try {
      const job = await api(`/api/citations/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`);
      message.textContent = job.step || "Traitement en cours…";
      if (job.status === "running") { setTimeout(() => poll(id), 2000); return; }
      button.disabled = !enabled;
      await dates();
      if (job.status === "failed") {
        message.textContent = `Échec : ${job.error}. Les mises à jour réussies sont conservées. Rechargez la page pour actualiser les chiffres affichés.`;
      } else if (job.kind === "citations") {
        const r = job.result || {};
        sessionStorage.setItem("sequoia-citations-result", `${r.updated || 0} articles actualisés ; ${r.requested_ids || 0} identifiants interrogés ; ${r.not_found || 0} articles sans résultat ; ${r.searched_missing_ids || 0} recherches pour identifiants absents ; ${r.unresolved || 0} articles encore sans identifiant.`);
        location.reload();
      } else message.textContent = "Traitement terminé. Vous pouvez rafraîchir les citations.";
    } catch (error) {
      message.textContent = `Suivi indisponible : ${error.message}. Nouvelle tentative…`;
      setTimeout(() => poll(id), 5000);
    }
  }
  async function restore() {
    const data = await api("/api/citations/latest");
    enabled = data.enabled;
    button.disabled = !enabled || data.busy;
    if (data.job?.status === "running") poll(data.job.id);
    else if (data.busy) { message.textContent = "Un traitement est déjà en cours…"; setTimeout(restore, 5000); }
    else if (!enabled) message.textContent = "Rafraîchissement désactivé dans cet environnement.";
  }
  button.addEventListener("click", async () => {
    button.disabled = true;
    try {
      const data = await api("/api/pipelines/citations", {method: "POST"});
      poll(data.job_id);
    } catch (error) {
      message.textContent = error.message;
      try { await restore(); } catch (_) { button.disabled = false; }
    }
  });
  const result = sessionStorage.getItem("sequoia-citations-result");
  if (result) { message.textContent = result; sessionStorage.removeItem("sequoia-citations-result"); }
  dates().catch(error => { date.textContent = error.message; });
  restore().catch(error => { message.textContent = `Suivi indisponible : ${error.message}`; });
});
</script>
```


```{ojs}
html`
<div class="ranking-list">

  ${topCitedPublications.map((d, i) => {

    const articleUrl =
      d.url
        ? d.url
        : d.doi
          ? (
              String(d.doi).startsWith("http")
                ? d.doi
                : `https://doi.org/${d.doi}`
            )
          : null

    return articleUrl
      ? html`
          <a
            class="ranking-row"
            href=${articleUrl}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            title=${d.title || "Ouvrir la publication"}
          >

            <span class="ranking-rank">
              ${i + 1}
            </span>

            <div class="ranking-content">

              <div class="ranking-title">
                ${d.title || "Sans titre"}
              </div>

              <div class="ranking-meta">
                ${String(d.year ?? "")}
                ${
                  d.authors
                    ? ` · ${shortAuthors(d.authors)}`
                    : ""
                }
              </div>

            </div>

            <div class="ranking-score">
              <strong>
                ${Number(d.citations).toLocaleString("fr-FR")}
              </strong>
              <span>citations</span>
            </div>

          </a>
        `
      : ""
  })}

</div>
`
```

## Publications associées

:::

::: {.publication-search-card}

**RECHERCHE PAR TITRE OU AUTEUR**

```{ojs}
viewof publicationSearch = Inputs.text({
  placeholder: "Ex. transformer, Dupont, robotique..."
})
```

:::

```{ojs}
publicationSearchQuery =
  String(publicationSearch || "")
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()

displayedPublications = filteredPublications
  .filter(
    d =>
      publicationSearchQuery === "" ||
      String(d.title || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(publicationSearchQuery) ||
      String(d.authors || "")
        .toLowerCase()
        .includes(publicationSearchQuery)
  )
  .slice()
  .sort(
    (a, b) =>
      Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0) ||
      String(a.title || "").localeCompare(String(b.title || ""))
  )
```

```{ojs}
html`
<div class="publication-result-summary">
  <strong>${displayedPublications.length.toLocaleString("fr-FR")}</strong>
  publication${displayedPublications.length > 1 ? "s" : ""}
  correspondant à la sélection
</div>
`
```

::: {.publication-card}

```{ojs}
Inputs.table(
  displayedPublications.map(d => ({
    Année: String(d.year ?? ""),
    Titre: d.title || "",
    Auteurs: d.authors || "",
    Pilier: d.pillar || "",
    Axe: d.axis || "",
    Citations:
      d.citations == null || d.citations === ""
        ? ""
        : Number(d.citations),
    "Citations actualisées le": d.refreshed_at ? new Date(d.refreshed_at).toLocaleString("fr-FR") : "—",
    HAL: d.url || "",
    DOI: d.doi || ""
  })),
  {
    rows: 8,

    columns: [
      "Année",
      "Titre",
      "Auteurs",
      "Pilier",
      "Axe",
      "Citations",
      "Citations actualisées le",
      "HAL",
      "DOI"
    ],

    width: {
      Année: 70,
      Titre: 330,
      Auteurs: 240,
      Pilier: 145,
      Axe: 200,
      Citations: 85,
      HAL: 85,
      DOI: 85
    },

    format: {
      Citations: value =>
        value === "" || value == null
          ? "—"
          : value.toLocaleString("fr-FR"),

      HAL: value =>
        value
          ? html`<a href=${value} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">HAL</a>`
          : "",

      DOI: value => {
        if (!value) return ""

        const doiUrl =
          String(value).startsWith("http")
            ? value
            : `https://doi.org/${value}`

        return html`<a href=${doiUrl} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">DOI</a>`
      }
    }
  }
)
```
